newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks end lower as brewers, banks fall.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks end lower as brewers, banks fall.

text.p: Colombian stocks fell on Wednesday, led by brewing and banking shares, brokers said.

Bogota's IBB index dropped 0.59 percent to 1,062.25 on trading of stock worth 1.67 billion pesos, while Medellin's IBOMED general price index fell 0.18 percent to 16,702.37, with four billion pesos of shares changing hands.

A decision by the United States on whether to "certify" Colombia as a trustworthy ally in the war against illicit drugs, or to blacklist the country for a second consecutive year, is still weighing on the market, one Bogota broker said. Washington is due to decide on Friday.
